headline: Iran War Odds Through 2026
status: Tracking runs to Dec. 31, where the odds are limited war 66%, escalated 13%, MOU-style 14% and comprehensive 7%. Iran sent a nuclear proposal through Qatar, but only for discussion after the US meets its seven demands, with no concrete enrichment cut and no acceptance of US sequencing, so neither deal tripwire fires; the tanker fires Iran claims are unnamed and unconfirmed, and the Theodore Roosevelt is still two weeks out, so the odds hold.

bets.cond: Iran accepts US sequencing, or round two is set with text
Iran ends strait tolls and permits, or declares Hormuz open to all shipping
Iran offers a concrete cut in enrichment capacity, in text or on the record
